      "text": "Based on the lecture slides provided and the specific examples from the 2021 and 2022 colloquiums, the \"First Colloquium\" focuses heavily on **Mechanics** (Kinematics, Dynamics, Energy, Momentum, and Rotation).\n\nHere is a curated list of formulas and concepts you should write on your A4 sheets. I have used the **notation found in your slides** (e.g., $G$ for momentum, $J$ for moment of inertia, $A$ for work) to avoid confusion.\n\n### 1. Matematika in Osnove (Math \u0026 Basics)\n*   **Trigonometrija (Right triangle):**\n    *   $\\sin \\phi \u003d \\frac{\\text{nasprotna}}{\\text{hipotenuza}}$, $\\cos \\phi \u003d \\frac{\\text{priležna}}{\\text{hipotenuza}}$, $\\tan \\phi \u003d \\frac{\\sin \\phi}{\\cos \\phi}$\n    *   $v_x \u003d v \\cos \\phi$, $v_y \u003d v \\sin \\phi$ (pri razstavljanju sil/hitrosti)\n    *   $sin^2x + cos^2x \u003d 1$\n*   **Kvadratna enačba:** $ax^2 + bx + c \u003d 0 \\rightarrow x_{1,2} \u003d \\frac{-b \\pm \\sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$\n*   **Odvod (Hitrost/Pospešek):** $\\dot{x} \u003d \\frac{dx}{dt}$, $\\ddot{x} \u003d \\frac{d^2x}{dt^2}$\n\n### 2. Kinematika (Kinematics)\n**Premo gibanje (1D):**\n*   **Enakomerno:** $v \u003d \\text{konst}$, $x \u003d x_0 + vt$\n*   **Enakomerno pospešeno:** $a \u003d \\text{konst}$\n    *   $v \u003d v_0 + at$\n    *   $x \u003d x_0 + v_0 t + \\frac{1}{2}at^2$\n    *   $v^2 \u003d v_0^2 + 2a(x - x_0)$ (Brezčasna enačba)\n\n**Poševni met (Projectile Motion):**\n*(Gledano iz točke meta $x_0\u003d0, y_0\u003d0$)*\n*   $a_x \u003d 0$, $a_y \u003d -g$\n*   $v_x \u003d v_0 \\cos \\phi$ (konstantna)\n*   $v_y(t) \u003d v_0 \\sin \\phi - gt$\n*   $x(t) \u003d (v_0 \\cos \\phi) \\cdot t$\n*   $y(t) \u003d (v_0 \\sin \\phi) \\cdot t - \\frac{1}{2}gt^2$\n*   **Domet (na isti višini):** $D \u003d \\frac{v_0^2 \\sin(2\\phi)}{g}$\n*   **Maksimalna višina:** $H \u003d \\frac{v_0^2 \\sin^2 \\phi}{2g}$\n\n### 3. Kroženje (Circular Motion)\n*   **Kotna hitrost:** $\\omega \u003d \\frac{d\\phi}{dt} \u003d 2\\pi \\nu \u003d \\frac{2\\pi}{t_0}$\n*   **Zveza z linearnimi količinami:**\n    *   $l \u003d r \\phi$ (ločna dolžina)\n    *   $v \u003d \\omega r$ (obodna hitrost)\n    *   $a_t \u003d \\alpha r$ (tangencialni pospešek)\n    *   $a_r \u003d \\omega^2 r \u003d \\frac{v^2}{r}$ (radialni/centripetalni pospešek)\n*   **Enakomerno pospešeno kroženje ($\\alpha \u003d \\text{konst}$):**\n    *   $\\omega \u003d \\omega_0 + \\alpha t$\n    *   $\\phi \u003d \\phi_0 + \\omega_0 t + \\frac{1}{2}\\alpha t^2$\n\n### 4. Dinamika - Newtonovi zakoni (Dynamics)\n*   **II. Newtonov zakon:** $\\sum \\vec{F} \u003d m\\vec{a}$\n*   **Sila teže:** $F_g \u003d mg$\n*   **Sila vzmeti:** $F_{vz} \u003d -kx$\n*   **Sila lepenja/trenja (Friction):**\n    *   Lepenje (miruje): $F_l \\leq k_l F_N$\n    *   Trenje (drsi): $F_t \u003d k_t F_N$\n    *   *$F_N$ je sila podlage (na klancu $F_N \u003d mg \\cos \\beta$)*\n*   **Sila upora (Drag):**\n    *   Linearni: $F_u \\propto v$ (majhne hitrosti)\n    *   Kvadratni: $F_u \u003d \\frac{1}{2} C S \\rho v^2$ (velike hitrosti)\n\n### 5. Delo in Energija (Work \u0026 Energy)\n*   **Delo sile:** $A \u003d \\int \\vec{F} \\cdot d\\vec{r} \u003d F s \\cos \\phi$ (če je sila konstantna)\n    *   Delo teže: $A \u003d -mg(h_2 - h_1)$\n    *   Delo trenja je negativno.\n*   **Kinetična energija:** $W_k \u003d \\frac{1}{2}mv^2$\n*   **Potencialna energija:**\n    *   Gravitacijska: $W_p \u003d mgh$\n    *   Prožnostna: $W_{pr} \u003d \\frac{1}{2}kx^2$\n*   **Izrek o kinetični energiji:** $A \u003d \\Delta W_k \u003d W_{k,konec} - W_{k,začetek}$\n*   **Ohranitev mehanske energije (če ni trenja/upora):**\n    *   $W_{k1} + W_{p1} \u003d W_{k2} + W_{p2}$\n*   **Moč (Power):** $P \u003d \\frac{dA}{dt} \u003d \\vec{F} \\cdot \\vec{v}$\n\n### 6. Gibalna količina in Trki (Momentum)\n*   **Gibalna količina:** $\\vec{G} \u003d m\\vec{v}$\n*   **Sunek sile:** $\\int \\vec{F} dt \u003d \\Delta \\vec{G} \u003d \\vec{G}_{konec} - \\vec{G}_{začetek}$\n*   **Ohranitev gibalne količine (če ni zunanjih sil):** $\\sum \\vec{G}_{prej} \u003d \\sum \\vec{G}_{potem}$\n*   **Trki:**\n    *   **Prožni trk:** Ohranja se $G$ in $W_k$.\n        *   $m_1 v_1 + m_2 v_2 \u003d m_1 v_1\u0027 + m_2 v_2\u0027$\n        *   $\\frac{1}{2}m_1 v_1^2 + \\dots \u003d \\frac{1}{2}m_1 v_1\u0027^2 + \\dots$\n    *   **Neprožni trk:** Telesi se sprimeta ($v_1\u0027 \u003d v_2\u0027 \u003d v\u0027$). Ohranja se samo $G$.\n        *   $m_1 v_1 + m_2 v_2 \u003d (m_1 + m_2)v\u0027$\n\n### 7. Vrtenje togega telesa (Rotation)\n*(Crucial for the cylinder/pulley problems in your exams)*\n*   **Navor (Torque):** $M \u003d r F \\sin \\phi$ (ročica $\\times$ sila) ali $\\vec{M} \u003d \\vec{r} \\times \\vec{F}$\n*   **II. Newtonov zakon za vrtenje:** $\\sum M \u003d J \\alpha$\n*   **Vztrajnostni moment ($J$):**\n    *   Točkasto telo: $J \u003d mr^2$\n    *   Valj/Disk (poln): $J \u003d \\frac{1}{2}mR^2$\n    *   Obroč (prazen): $J \u003d mR^2$\n    *   Krogla: $J \u003d \\frac{2}{5}mR^2$\n*   **Steinerjev izrek:** $J \u003d J_{težišče} + md^2$ (d \u003d razdalja premika osi)\n*   **Rotacijska kinetična energija:** $W_{rot} \u003d \\frac{1}{2}J\\omega^2$\n*   **Kotaljenje (brez drsenja):**\n    *   $v \u003d \\omega r$\n    *   $a \u003d \\alpha r$\n    *   Skupna energija pri kotaljenju: $W \u003d \\frac{1}{2}mv^2 + \\frac{1}{2}J\\omega^2$\n*   **Vrtilna količina:** $\\Gamma \u003d J\\omega$ (ohranitev: $J_1 \\omega_1 \u003d J_2 \\omega_2$, če $\\sum M \u003d 0$)\n\n### 8. Težišče (Center of Mass)\n*   $x_T \u003d \\frac{\\sum m_i x_i}{\\sum m_i}$, $\\vec{r}_T \u003d \\frac{\\int \\vec{r} dm}{m}$\n\n### 9. Useful Specific Cases for Colloquium\n*   **Statika (Ravnovesje):**\n    *   $\\sum F_x \u003d 0$, $\\sum F_y \u003d 0$\n    *   $\\sum M \u003d 0$ (Izberi osišče tam, kjer deluje največ neznanih sil, da se jih znebiš).\n    *   *Example 2 in 2022:* For pulling a cylinder over a step, balance torques around the **edge of the step** (pivot point).\n*   **Differential Equations (from 2021 Bonus):**\n    *   If $F \u003d -Cv$, then $ma \u003d -Cv \\rightarrow m\\frac{dv}{dt} \u003d -Cv$. Separate variables: $\\int \\frac{dv}{v} \u003d -\\int \\frac{C}{m} dt$.\n\n### 10. Gravitacija (Just in case)\n*   $F_g \u003d G \\frac{m_1 m_2}{r^2}$\n*   $W_p \u003d -G \\frac{m_1 m_2}{r}$\n*   3. Keplerjev zakon: $\\frac{r^3}{t_0^2} \u003d \\text{konst}$\n\n---\n\n**Tip for printing:** Organize these by topic. Make sure to clearly label \"Translation\" vs \"Rotation\" (e.g., Force vs Torque, Mass vs Moment of Inertia, Velocity vs Angular Velocity) as many problems require combining them (like the pulley problem).",

      "text": "This is the most critical part of rigid body mechanics (rotation). To solve problems like the \"cylinder over a step\" or \"massive pulley\" from your exams, you need to know exactly how linear forces translate into rotational torque.\n\nHere is how you link them on your cheat sheet:\n\n### 1. The Basic Definition (Geometry)\nTorque ($M$) is the \"turning effect\" of a Force ($F$).\n\n$$M \u003d r \\cdot F \\cdot \\sin(\\phi)$$\n\n*   **$r$**: The distance from the pivot point (axis of rotation) to where the force is applied.\n*   **$F$**: The magnitude of the force.\n*   **$\\phi$**: The angle between the direction of the force and the arm vector $\\vec{r}$.\n\n**The \"Lever Arm\" Shortcut (Easier for exams):**\nInstead of worrying about the angle every time, just use the **perpendicular distance**.\n$$M \u003d F \\cdot d_\\perp$$\n*   **$d_\\perp$**: The shortest distance from the pivot point to the *line of action* of the force.\n\n\u003e **Example:** If you push a door perpendicular to the surface, $\\phi\u003d90^\\circ$, $\\sin(90)\u003d1$, so simply **$M \u003d r \\cdot F$**.\n\n---\n\n### 2. The Dynamic Link (Newton\u0027s 2nd Law)\nThis is the standard procedure for solving problems where things move/rotate (like Task 2 in 2021). You almost always set up a system of two equations.\n\n**Step 1: Write Linear Law**\n$$\\sum F \u003d m \\cdot a$$\n*(Sum of forces \u003d mass $\\times$ linear acceleration)*\n\n**Step 2: Write Rotational Law**\n$$\\sum M \u003d J \\cdot \\alpha$$\n*(Sum of torques \u003d Moment of Inertia $\\times$ angular acceleration)*\n\n**Step 3: The \"Bridge\" Equation**\nThis links the linear world ($a$) with the rotational world ($\\alpha$):\n$$a \u003d \\alpha \\cdot r \\quad \\text{or} \\quad \\alpha \u003d \\frac{a}{r}$$\n*(Valid if the rope doesn\u0027t slip or the object rolls without slipping).*\n\n---\n\n### 3. Common Exam Scenarios\n\n#### A. Real Pulley (Masiven škripec)\n*Context: A mass $m$ hanging from a rope over a heavy pulley with radius $R$ and inertia $J$.*\n\n1.  **Force on Mass:** $mg - F_{vrv} \u003d ma$\n2.  **Torque on Pulley:** The rope tension ($F_{vrv}$) creates the torque. Since the rope is tangent to the pulley, the angle is $90^\\circ$.\n    $$M \u003d F_{vrv} \\cdot R$$\n3.  **Equation:** $F_{vrv} \\cdot R \u003d J \\cdot \\alpha$\n4.  **Substitute:** Replace $\\alpha$ with $a/R$.\n\n#### B. Rolling Object (Kotaljenje)\n*Context: A cylinder rolling down a hill or being pulled.*\nFriction ($F_{tr}$) is usually the force creating the torque that causes rotation.\n\n1.  **Linear:** $F_{vleka} - F_{tr} \u003d ma$\n2.  **Rotation (around center):** The pulling force goes through the center (produces no torque). Only friction creates torque.\n    $$M \u003d F_{tr} \\cdot R$$\n3.  **Equation:** $F_{tr} \\cdot R \u003d J \\cdot \\alpha$\n\n#### C. Static Equilibrium (The Step Problem - 2022 Task 2)\n*Context: Pulling a cylinder over a step. It rotates around the edge of the step.*\n\n1.  **Pivot Point:** The corner of the step.\n2.  **Condition:** $\\sum M \u003d 0$ (Torque trying to rotate it up \u003d Torque trying to keep it down).\n3.  ** Forces:**\n    *   **Pulling Force ($F$):** Creates torque $M_{pull} \u003d F \\cdot (\\text{lever arm of F})$.\n    *   **Gravity ($mg$):** Creates torque $M_{grav} \u003d mg \\cdot (\\text{horizontal distance from corner to center})$.\n4.  **Equation:**\n    $$F \\cdot d_{\\perp 1} \u003d mg \\cdot d_{\\perp 2}$$\n\n---\n\n### Summary for your A4 Sheet:\n\n**Zveza Sila - Navor (Force-Torque Link):**\n1.  **Definicija:** $M \u003d r F \\sin \\phi$ ali $M \u003d F \\cdot d_\\perp$ (ročica)\n2.  **Predznak:** Vrti v nasprotni smeri urinega kazalca (+), v smeri urinega kazalca (-) (ali obratno, samo bodi dosleden).\n3.  **Dinamika (Most):**\n    *   $\\sum F \u003d ma$\n    *   $\\sum M \u003d J \\alpha$\n    *   **$a \u003d \\alpha r$** (pogoj brez drsenja)\n4.  **Ravnovesje (Statika):** $\\sum F \u003d 0$ in $\\sum M \u003d 0$.",

KOLOKVIJ (Comprehensive Cheat Sheet)\n\n## 1. ROTACIJA (Rotation) \u0026 GIBALNA KOLIČINA\n*Key for the \"Skater\" and \"Collision\" problems.*\n\n*   **Vrtilna količina (Angular Momentum):** $\\Gamma \u003d J \\omega$\n*   **Ohranitev vrtilne količine (Conservation):**\n    Če je vsota zunanjih navorov $M\u003d0$:\n    $$ J_1 \\omega_1 \u003d J_2 \\omega_2 $$\n    *(Primer: drsalec skrči roke $\\rightarrow J$ se zmanjša, $\\omega$ se poveča)*\n*   **Rotacijska kinetična energija:** $W_{rot} \u003d \\frac{1}{2} J \\omega^2$\n    *   Delo pri spremembi $J$: $A \u003d \\Delta W_{rot} \u003d \\frac{1}{2}J_2\\omega_2^2 - \\frac{1}{2}J_1\\omega_1^2$\n*   **Vztrajnostni momenti ($J$):**\n    *   Točkasto telo: $mr^2$\n    *   Valj/Disk: $\\frac{1}{2}mR^2$\n    *   Palica (sredina): $\\frac{1}{12}mL^2$ | Palica (kraj): $\\frac{1}{3}mL^2$\n    *   **Steinerjev izrek:** $J \u003d J_{težišče} + m d^2$\n*   **Trki (Collisions):**\n    *   Gibalna količina: $m_1 v_1 + m_2 v_2 \u003d m_1 v_1\u0027 + m_2 v_2\u0027$ (vedno se ohranja)\n    *   Prožni trk (Elastic): Ohranja se tudi $W_k$.\n    *   Neprožni trk (Inelastic): Telesi se sprimeta ($v\u0027$). $W_k$ se ne ohranja.\n\n## 2. GRAVITACIJA (Gravitation)\n*Key for \"Satellite\" and \"Binary Star\" problems.*\n\n*   **Sila:** $F \u003d G \\frac{m_1 m_2}{r^2}$\n*   **Potencialna energija:** $W_p \u003d - G \\frac{m_1 m_2}{r}$ (pazi na minus!)\n*   **Kroženje satelita (Circular Orbit):**\n    Sila teže je centripetalna sila: $G \\frac{Mm}{r^2} \u003d m \\frac{v^2}{r} \u003d m \\omega^2 r$\n    *   **Hitrost na tiru:** $v \u003d \\sqrt{\\frac{GM}{r}}$\n    *   **Obhodni čas (Kepler III):** $t_0^2 \u003d \\frac{4\\pi^2}{GM} r^3$\n*   **Ubežna hitrost:** $v_u \u003d \\sqrt{\\frac{2GM}{R}}$\n*   **Ohranitev energije v orbiti:** $W_{skupna} \u003d \\frac{1}{2}mv^2 - G\\frac{Mm}{r} \u003d const.$\n\n## 3. MEHANIKA TEKOČIN (Fluids)\n*Key for \"Bottle\", \"Emptying Tank\", and \"Sinking\" problems.*\n\n### A. Hidrostatika\n*   **Tlak:** $p \u003d p_0 + \\rho g h$\n*   **Vzgon (Archimedes):** $F_{vz} \u003d \\rho_{tek} \\cdot V_{pod} \\cdot g$\n    *   *Plavanje:* $F_{vz} \u003d m_{telesa} g \\rightarrow \\rho_{tek} V_{pod} \u003d \\rho_{telesa} V_{cel}$\n    *   *Plavanje z luknjo (2009 naloga 4):* Volumen telesa je volumen *materiala*, volumen izpodrinjene vode pa je zunanji volumen.\n\n### B. Hidrodinamika (Bernoulli)\n$$ p_1 + \\rho g h_1 + \\frac{1}{2}\\rho v_1^2 \u003d p_2 + \\rho g h_2 + \\frac{1}{2}\\rho v_2^2 $$\n*   **Torricellijev zakon (Iztekanje):** $v \u003d \\sqrt{2gh}$ (če je zunanji tlak povsod enak).\n*   **Iztekanje pod tlakom (Steklenica - 2022 naloga 3):**\n    Če je v steklenici nad tekočino tlak $p_{notranji} \u003e p_{zunaj}$:\n    $$ v \u003d \\sqrt{\\frac{2(p_{not} - p_{zun})}{\\rho} + 2gh} $$\n\n### C. Čas iztekanja (Differential Equations - 2011 naloga 3)\nKo se gladina niža, se hitrost manjša.\n1.  Kontinuiteta: $S_{posode} \\cdot \\frac{dh}{dt} \u003d - S_{luknje} \\cdot v(h)$\n2.  Zamenjaj $v(h) \u003d \\sqrt{2gh}$:\n    $$ \\frac{dh}{dt} \u003d - \\frac{S_{luknje}}{S_{posode}} \\sqrt{2g} \\sqrt{h} $$\n3.  Integriraj od $H_{začetni}$ do $H_{končni}$:\n    $$ \\int_{H_z}^{H_k} \\frac{dh}{\\sqrt{h}} \u003d - \\frac{S_l}{S_p} \\sqrt{2g} \\int_{0}^{t} dt $$\n    *Rešitev (za praznjenje do dna):* $t \u003d \\frac{S_p}{S_l} \\sqrt{\\frac{2H}{g}}$\n\n### D. Upor in Viskoznost\n*   **Kvadratni zakon (Turbulentno/Hitro - Smučar):** $F_u \u003d \\frac{1}{2} c_v \\rho S v^2$\n*   **Linearni zakon (Laminarno/Počasi):** $F_u \u003d -k v$\n*   **Padanje z uporom (Končna hitrost):**\n    Ko se pospeševanje ustavi ($a\u003d0$): $F_g - F_{vz} - F_{upor} \u003d 0$\n\n---\n\n## 4. TOPLOTA IN TERMODINAMIKA\n*Key for \"Ice Growth\" and \"Ideal Gas\" problems.*\n\n### A. Plinska enačba\n$$ pV \u003d \\frac{m}{M} RT \\quad (R \u003d 8314 \\text{ J/kmol K}) $$\n*   **Spremembe:**\n    *   Izobarna ($p\u003dconst$): $V_1/T_1 \u003d V_2/T_2$\n    *   Izohorna ($V\u003dconst$): $p_1/T_1 \u003d p_2/T_2$\n    *   Izotermna ($T\u003dconst$): $p_1 V_1 \u003d p_2 V_2$\n    *   Adiabatna ($Q\u003d0$): $p V^\\kappa \u003d const$ ($\\kappa \u003d c_p/c_v \\approx 1.4$ za zrak)\n\n### B. Prvi zakon termodinamike\n$$ Q + A_{zun} \u003d \\Delta W_n $$\n*(Pazi na predznake: $Q$ dovedena +, $A_{zun}$ delo na plin +)*\n*   **Notranja energija:** $\\Delta W_n \u003d m c_v \\Delta T$\n*   **Delo:** $A \u003d -\\int p dV$ (Delo plina je $p \\Delta V$)\n*   **Specifična toplota:** $Q \u003d m c \\Delta T$\n*   **Fazne spremembe:** $Q \u003d m q_t$ (taljenje), $Q \u003d m q_i$ (izparjevanje)\n\n### C. Prevajanje toplote (Rast ledu - 2022 naloga 4)\nTo je \"trik\" vprašanje, ki se pogosto pojavlja.\nToplotni tok skozi plast ledu debeline $x$:\n$$ P \u003d \\frac{dQ}{dt} \u003d \\lambda S \\frac{T_{voda} - T_{zrak}}{x} $$\nToplota, ki se sprosti pri zamrzovanju nove plasti debeline $dx$:\n$$ dQ \u003d dm \\cdot q_t \u003d (\\rho_{led} S dx) \\cdot q_t $$\n**Diferencialna enačba:**\n$$ \\rho S q_t \\frac{dx}{dt} \u003d \\lambda S \\frac{\\Delta T}{x} $$\n$$ x dx \u003d \\frac{\\lambda \\Delta T}{\\rho q_t} dt $$\nIntegriraj od debeline $x_1$ do $x_2$:\n$$ \\frac{1}{2}x_2^2 - \\frac{1}{2}x_1^2 \u003d \\frac{\\lambda \\Delta T}{\\rho q_t} t $$\n*(To formulo za čas $t$ si zapiši, da je ne izvajaš vsakič!)*\n\n---\n\n## 5. ELASTOMEHANIKA (Just in case)\n*   **Hookov zakon:** $\\sigma \u003d E \\epsilon \\rightarrow \\frac{F}{S} \u003d E \\frac{\\Delta l}{l}$\n*   **Prožnostna energija:** $W_{pr} \u003d \\frac{1}{2} k x^2$\n\n---\n\n### KONSTANTE (Write these down to save time)\n*   $g \\approx 9.81 \\, m/s^2$\n*   $G \u003d 6.67 \\times 10^{-11} \\, m^3/kgs^2$\n*   $R \u003d 8314 \\, J/kmol K$\n*   $p_{atm} \\approx 10^5 \\, Pa$ (1 bar)\n*   $0^\\circ C \u003d 273.15 \\, K$",

        "text": ")\nTo je \"trik\" vprašanje, ki se pogosto pojavlja.\nToplotni tok skozi plast"

      "text": "Based on the lecture slides and the specific exam problems (2009, 2011, 2020), the **Second Colloquium** is cumulative but focuses heavily on **Rotational Dynamics**, **Fluids**, **Oscillations**, and **Thermodynamics**.\n\nHere is the continuation of your cheat sheet. It starts where basic mechanics ends and covers the advanced topics required for the 2nd colloquium.\n\n---\n\n### 8. DINAMIKA VRTENJA (Advanced Rotation)\n*Crucial for \"Skater\" (2011), \"Colliding Rod\" (2021), and \"Rolling\" problems.*\n\n*   **Vrtilna količina (Angular Momentum):**\n    $$ \\vec{\\Gamma} \u003d \\vec{r} \\times \\vec{G} \\quad \\text{ali} \\quad \\Gamma \u003d J \\omega $$\n*   **Izrek o vrtilni količini (Conservation):**\n    Če je vsota zunanjih navorov $\\sum M \u003d 0$:\n    $$ \\Gamma_{prej} \u003d \\Gamma_{potem} \\quad \\Rightarrow \\quad J_1 \\omega_1 \u003d J_2 \\omega_2 $$\n    *(Primer: drsalec skrči roke $\\to J$ se zmanjša, $\\omega$ se poveča. Energija se NE ohranja, ampak poveča zaradi dela mišic).*\n*   **Delo pri vrtenju:**\n    $$ A \u003d \\int M d\\varphi \u003d \\Delta W_{k,rot} \u003d \\frac{1}{2}J_2\\omega_2^2 - \\frac{1}{2}J_1\\omega_1^2 $$\n*   **Steinerjev izrek (Parallel Axis Theorem):**\n    Če se telo ne vrti okoli težišča, ampak okoli osi, zamaknjene za razdaljo $d$:\n    $$ J \u003d J_{težišče} + m d^2 $$\n    *(Primer: palica, vpeta na krajišču: $J \u003d \\frac{1}{12}ml^2 + m(l/2)^2 \u003d \\frac{1}{3}ml^2$)*.\n*   **Trk (Rotation + Translation):**\n    Pri trku krogle v palico (2021 naloga 1) se ohranja vrtilna količina glede na osišče:\n    $$ \\Gamma_{krogla} \u003d \\Gamma_{palica} + \\Gamma_{krogla}\u0027 \\quad \\Rightarrow \\quad m v r \u003d J_{pal} \\omega + m v\u0027 r $$\n\n---\n\n### 9. ELASTOMEHANIKA (Deformation)\n*   **Hookov zakon (Nateg/Stisk):**\n    $$ \\frac{F}{S} \u003d E \\frac{\\Delta l}{l} \\quad (\\sigma \u003d E \\varepsilon) $$\n    ($E$ \u003d prožnostni modul, $S$ \u003d presek).\n*   **Stisljivost (Tlak):** $\\frac{\\Delta V}{V} \u003d -\\chi \\Delta p$\n*   **Strižna obremenitev:** $\\frac{F}{S} \u003d G \\gamma$ ($G$ \u003d strižni modul).\n*   **Toplotno raztezanje:**\n    *   Dolžinsko: $\\Delta l \u003d \\alpha l \\Delta T$\n    *   Prostorninsko: $\\Delta V \u003d \\beta V \\Delta T$ (za trdne snovi $\\beta \\approx 3\\alpha$).\n\n---\n\n### 10. MEHANIKA TEKOČIN (Fluids)\n*This appears in almost every exam (2009, 2011, 2020).*\n\n**A. Hidrostatika (Mirujoča tekočina)**\n*   **Tlak:** $p(h) \u003d p_0 + \\rho g h$\n*   **Vzgon (Archimedes):**\n    $$ F_{vz} \u003d \\rho_{tek} g V_{izpodrinjen} $$\n    *   *Pogoj za plavanje:* $F_{vz} \u003d F_g \\Rightarrow \\rho_{tek} V_{pod} \u003d \\rho_{telo} V_{cel}$\n    *   *Sile na potopljeno telo (2020 naloga 4):* $m a \u003d m g - F_{vz} - F_{upora}$\n\n**B. Hidrodinamika (Idealna tekočina)**\n*   **Kontinuitetna enačba:** $S_1 v_1 \u003d S_2 v_2 \u003d \\Phi_V$ (volumski pretok [m³/s])\n*   **Bernoullijeva enačba (Ohranitev energije):**\n    $$ p_1 + \\rho g h_1 + \\frac{1}{2}\\rho v_1^2 \u003d p_2 + \\rho g h_2 + \\frac{1}{2}\\rho v_2^2 \u003d const. $$\n*   **Iztekanje iz posode (Torricelli):**\n    $$ v \u003d \\sqrt{2gh} $$\n    *Če je nad tekočino nadtlak $\\Delta p$:* $v \u003d \\sqrt{2gh + \\frac{2\\Delta p}{\\rho}}$\n\n**C. Viskoznost in Upor (Realna tekočina)**\n*   **Viskozna sila:** $F \u003d \\eta S \\frac{dv}{dz}$\n*   **Poiseuillov zakon (pretok skozi cev):** $\\Phi_V \u003d \\frac{\\pi r^4 \\Delta p}{8 \\eta l}$\n*   **Sila upora na telo (Drag Force):**\n    1.  **Linearni (Stokes):** $F_u \u003d 6\\pi r \\eta v$ (za kroglo pri majhnih hitrostih).\n        *   *Diferencialna enačba (2020 naloga 4):* $m \\frac{dv}{dt} \u003d F_{neto} - k v$.\n    2.  **Kvadratni (Newton):** $F_u \u003d \\frac{1}{2} c_u \\rho S v^2$ (pri velikih hitrostih - smučar 2009).\n*   **Končna hitrost padanja:** Ko je $a\u003d0 \\Rightarrow F_g - F_{vz} - F_{u} \u003d 0$.\n\n---\n\n### 11. NIHANJE (Oscillations)\n*   **Splošna enačba:** $x(t) \u003d x_0 \\sin(\\omega t + \\delta)$\n    *   $v(t) \u003d \\omega x_0 \\cos(\\omega t + \\delta)$\n    *   $a(t) \u003d -\\omega^2 x_0 \\sin(\\omega t + \\delta)$\n*   **Krožna frekvenca $\\omega$:**\n    *   Vzmet: $\\omega \u003d \\sqrt{k/m}$\n    *   Nitno nihalo: $\\omega \u003d \\sqrt{g/l}$\n    *   Fizično nihalo: $\\omega \u003d \\sqrt{m g d / J}$ ($d$ \u003d razdalja os-težišče)\n*   **Energija:** $W \u003d \\frac{1}{2} k x_0^2 \u003d \\frac{1}{2} m v_{max}^2$\n*   **Dušeno nihanje:** $x(t) \u003d x_0 e^{-\\beta t} \\sin(\\omega\u0027 t)$\n\n---\n\n### 12. VALOVANJE (Waves) \u0026 ZVOK\n*   **Hitrost valovanja:** $c \u003d \\lambda \\nu \u003d \\frac{\\omega}{k}$\n*   **Valovna enačba:** $s(x,t) \u003d s_0 \\sin(\\omega t \\pm kx)$ ($k \u003d 2\\pi/\\lambda$)\n*   **Hitrost na struni:** $c \u003d \\sqrt{\\frac{F}{\\mu}}$ ($\\mu \u003d m/l$)\n*   **Hitrost zvoka:** $c \u003d \\sqrt{\\frac{\\kappa R T}{M}}$ ($\\kappa \u003d c_p/c_v$)\n*   **Dopplerjev pojav:**\n    $$ \\nu_s \u003d \\nu_v \\frac{c \\pm v_s}{c \\mp v_v} $$\n    *   Zgornji znaki (+ zgoraj, - spodaj): Približevanje.\n    *   Spodnji znaki: Oddaljevanje.\n    *   $v_s$: hitrost sprejemnika, $v_v$: hitrost vira.\n\n---\n\n### 13. TOPLOTA IN TERMODINAMIKA (Thermodynamics)\n\n**A. Plinska enačba (Idealni plin)**\n$$ pV \u003d \\frac{m}{M} RT \\quad \\text{ali} \\quad pV \u003d nRT $$\n*   $R \u003d 8314$ J/kmol K\n*   **Daltonov zakon:** $p \u003d \\sum p_i$ (tlak zmesi je vsota delnih tlakov).\n\n**B. Prvi zakon termodinamike**\n$$ Q + A \u003d \\Delta W_n $$\n*   **Dogovor o predznakih:**\n    *   $Q \u003e 0$: sistem prejme toploto.\n    *   $A \u003e 0$: delo opravljeno *NA* sistemu (stiskanje).\n    *   $A \u003c 0$: delo opravljeno *OD* sistema (razpenjanje).\n*   **Notranja energija:** $\\Delta W_n \u003d m c_v \\Delta T$ (za idealni plin vedno velja!).\n*   **Delo:** $A \u003d -\\int p dV$.\n\n**C. Prenos toplote**\n*   **Specifična toplota:** $Q \u003d m c \\Delta T$\n*   **Fazne spremembe:** $Q \u003d m q_t$ (taljenje), $Q \u003d m q_i$ (izparjevanje).\n*   **Prevajanje (Kondukcija):**\n    $$ P \u003d \\frac{dQ}{dt} \u003d \\lambda S \\frac{\\Delta T}{l} $$\n    *   $\\lambda$: toplotna prevodnost, $l$: debelina stene.\n\n**D. Vrste sprememb (Idealni plin)**\n\n| Sprememba | Pogoj | Enačba stanja | Delo ($A \u003d -\\int pdV$) | Toplota ($Q$) |\n| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |\n| **Izohorna** | $V\u003dconst$ | $p/T \u003d const$ | $A \u003d 0$ | $Q \u003d m c_v \\Delta T$ |\n| **Izobarna** | $p\u003dconst$ | $V/T \u003d const$ | $A \u003d -p \\Delta V$ | $Q \u003d m c_p \\Delta T$ |\n| **Izotermna**| $T\u003dconst$ | $pV \u003d const$ | $A \u003d m R T \\ln(V_1/V_2)$ | $Q \u003d -A$ |\n| **Adiabatna**| $Q\u003d0$ | $pV^\\kappa \u003d const$ | $A \u003d m c_v \\Delta T$ | $Q \u003d 0$ |\n\n*   $\\kappa \u003d c_p/c_v$. Za enoatomne pline $\\kappa \\approx 1.67$, dvoatomne $\\approx 1.4$.\n*   Mayerjeva enačba: $c_p \u003d c_v + R/M$.\n\n---\n\n### 🔥 SPECIAL CASES FOR EXAMS (Calculus Application)\n\n**1. Čas praznjenja posode (2011 Naloga 3)**\nKo gladina pada, se hitrost iztekanja manjša.\n$$ -S_{posode} dh \u003d S_{luknje} v dt $$\n$$ v \u003d \\sqrt{2gh} \\quad \\Rightarrow \\quad dt \u003d -\\frac{S_p}{S_l \\sqrt{2g}} h^{-1/2} dh $$\nIntegriraj od $H_{start}$ do $0$:\n$$ t \u003d \\frac{S_p}{S_l} \\sqrt{\\frac{2H}{g}} $$\n\n**2. Debeljenje ledu (2011 Naloga 4)**\nToplota strjevanja mora uiti skozi plast ledu debeline $x$.\n$$ P \u003d \\lambda S \\frac{\\Delta T}{x} \\quad \\text{in} \\quad dQ \u003d dm \\cdot q_t \u003d (\\rho S dx) q_t $$\n$$ \\frac{dQ}{dt} \u003d P \\Rightarrow \\rho S q_t \\frac{dx}{dt} \u003d \\lambda S \\frac{\\Delta T}{x} $$\nLoči spremenljivke ($x dx \\propto dt$) in integriraj:\n$$ \\frac{1}{2}x^2 \u003d \\frac{\\lambda \\Delta T}{\\rho q_t} t $$\nČas za debeljenje od $x_1$ do $x_2$: $t \u003d \\frac{\\rho q_t}{2 \\lambda \\Delta T} (x_2^2 - x_1^2)$.",

      }, {
        "text": "):* $m a \u003d m g - F_{vz} - F_{upora}$\n\n**B. Hidrodinam"
      }, {
        "text": "ika (Idealna tekočina)**\n*   **Kontinuitetna enačba:** $S_1 v_1 \u003d S"
      }, {
        "text": "_2 v_2 \u003d \\Phi_V$ (volumski pretok [m³/s])\n*   **Bernou"
      }, {
        "text": "llijeva enačba (Ohranitev energije):**\n    $$ p_1 + \\rho g h_1 + \\frac{"
      }, {
        "text": "1}{2}\\rho v_1^2 \u003d p_2 + \\rho g h_2 + \\frac"
      }, {
        "text": "{1}{2}\\rho v_2^2 \u003d const. $$\n*   **Iztekanje iz posode (Tor"
      }, {
        "text": "ricelli):**\n    $$ v \u003d \\sqrt{2gh} $$\n    *Če je nad te"
      }, {
        "text": "kočino nadtlak $\\Delta p$:* $v \u003d \\sqrt{2gh + \\frac{2\\Delta p"
      }, {
        "text": "}{\\rho}}$\n\n**C. Viskoznost in Upor (Realna tekočina)**\n*   **"
      }, {
        "text": "Viskozna sila:** $F \u003d \\eta S \\frac{dv}{dz}$\n*   **Poiseuillov zakon ("
      }, {
        "text": "pretok skozi cev):** $\\Phi_V \u003d \\frac{\\pi r^4 \\Delta p}{8 \\eta l"
      }, {
        "text": "}$\n*   **Sila upora na telo (Drag Force):**\n    1.  **Linearni ("
      }, {
        "text": "Stokes):** $F_u \u003d 6\\pi r \\eta v$ (za kroglo pri majhnih hitrost"
      }, {
        "text": "ih).\n        *   *Diferencialna enačba (2020 naloga 4):* $m \\frac{dv"
      }, {
        "text": "}{dt} \u003d F_{neto} - k v$.\n    2.  **Kvadratni (Newton):** $F_u"
      }, {
        "text": " \u003d \\frac{1}{2} c_u \\rho S v^2$ (pri velikih hitrostih -"
      }, {
        "text": " smučar 2009).\n*   **Končna hitrost padanja:** Ko je $a\u003d0 \\"
      }, {
        "text": "Rightarrow F_g - F_{vz} - F_{u} \u003d 0$.\n\n---\n\n### 11. NI"
      }, {
        "text": "HANJE (Oscillations)\n*   **Splošna enačba:** $x(t) \u003d x"
      }, {
        "text": "_0 \\sin(\\omega t + \\delta)$\n    *   $v(t) \u003d \\omega x_0 \\cos(\\"
      }, {
        "text": "omega t + \\delta)$\n    *   $a(t) \u003d -\\omega^2 x_0 \\sin(\\omega t + \\"
      }, {
        "text": "delta)$\n*   **Krožna frekvenca $\\omega$:**\n    *   Vzmet:"
      }, {
        "text": " $\\omega \u003d \\sqrt{k/m}$\n    *   Nitno nihalo: $\\omega \u003d \\sqrt{g/l}$\n"
      }, {
        "text": "    *   Fizično nihalo: $\\omega \u003d \\sqrt{m g d / J}$ ($d$ \u003d razdal"
      }, {
        "text": "ja os-težišče)\n*   **Energija:** $W \u003d \\frac{1}{2} k x"
      }, {
        "text": "_0^2 \u003d \\frac{1}{2} m v_{max}^2$\n*   **Dušeno nihanje"
      }, {
        "text": ":** $x(t) \u003d x_0 e^{-\\beta t} \\sin(\\omega\u0027 t)$\n\n---\n\n### 12. VAL"
      }, {
        "text": "OVANJE (Waves) \u0026 ZVOK\n*   **Hitrost valovanja:** $c \u003d \\lambda \\"
      }, {
        "text": "nu \u003d \\frac{\\omega}{k}$\n*   **Valovna enačba:** $s(x,t) \u003d s"
      }, {
        "text": "_0 \\sin(\\omega t \\pm kx)$ ($k \u003d 2\\pi/\\lambda$)\n*   **Hitrost"
      }, {
        "text": " na struni:** $c \u003d \\sqrt{\\frac{F}{\\mu}}$ ($\\mu \u003d m/l$)\n*   **Hitrost zvoka"
      }, {
        "text": ":** $c \u003d \\sqrt{\\frac{\\kappa R T}{M}}$ ($\\kappa \u003d c_p/c_"
      }, {
        "text": "v$)\n*   **Dopplerjev pojav:**\n    $$ \\nu_s \u003d \\nu_v \\frac{c \\pm v"
      }, {
        "text": "_s}{c \\mp v_v} $$\n    *   Zgornji znaki (+ zgoraj, - spodaj):"
      }, {
        "text": " Približevanje.\n    *   Spodnji znaki: Oddaljevanje.\n    *   "
      }, {
        "text": "$v_s$: hitrost sprejemnika, $v_v$: hitrost vira.\n\n---\n\n### 13."
      }, {
        "text": " TOPLOTA IN TERMODINAMIKA (Thermodynamics)\n\n**A. Plinska enačba (Idealni"
      }, {
        "text": " plin)**\n$$ pV \u003d \\frac{m}{M} RT \\quad \\text{ali} \\"
      }, {
        "text": "quad pV \u003d nRT $$\n*   $R \u003d 8314$ J/kmol K\n"
      }, {
        "text": "*   **Daltonov zakon:** $p \u003d \\sum p_i$ (tlak zmesi je vsota delnih tlakov).\n\n"
      }, {
        "text": "**B. Prvi zakon termodinamike**\n$$ Q + A \u003d \\Delta W_n $$\n*   **Dogovor o"
      }, {
        "text": " predznakih:**\n    *   $Q \u003e 0$: sistem prejme toploto.\n    *   $A \u003e "
      }, {
        "text": "0$: delo opravljeno *NA* sistemu (stiskanje).\n    *   $A \u003c 0$: delo oprav"
      }, {
        "text": "ljeno *OD* sistema (razpenjanje).\n*   **Notranja energija:** $\\Delta W_n \u003d m"
      }, {
        "text": " c_v \\Delta T$ (za idealni plin vedno velja!).\n*   **Delo:** $A \u003d -\\int p d"
      }, {
        "text": "V$.\n\n**C. Prenos toplote**\n*   **Specifična toplota:** $Q \u003d"
      }, {
        "text": " m c \\Delta T$\n*   **Fazne spremembe:** $Q \u003d m q_t$ (taljenje),"
      }, {
        "text": " $Q \u003d m q_i$ (izparjevanje).\n*   **Prevajanje (Kondukcija):**\n    $$"
      }, {
        "text": " P \u003d \\frac{dQ}{dt} \u003d \\lambda S \\frac{\\Delta T}{l} $$\n    *   $\\"
      }, {
        "text": "lambda$: toplotna prevodnost, $l$: debelina stene.\n\n**D. Vrste sprememb ("
      }, {
        "text": "Idealni plin)**\n\n| Sprememba | Pogoj | Enačba stanja | Delo ($A \u003d"
      }, {
        "text": " -\\int pdV$) | Toplota ($Q$) |\n| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |\n"
      }, {
        "text": "| **Izohorna** | $V\u003dconst$ | $p/T \u003d const$ | $A \u003d 0"
      }, {
        "text": "$ | $Q \u003d m c_v \\Delta T$ |\n| **Izobarna** | $p"
      }, {
        "text": "\u003dconst$ | $V/T \u003d const$ | $A \u003d -p \\Delta V$ | $Q \u003d m"
      }, {
        "text": " c_p \\Delta T$ |\n| **Izotermna**| $T\u003dconst$ | $"
      }, {
        "text": "pV \u003d const$ | $A \u003d m R T \\ln(V_1/V_2)$ | $Q \u003d"

        "text": " -A$ |\n| **Adiabatna**| $Q\u003d0$ | $pV^\\kappa \u003d const"
      }, {
        "text": "$ | $A \u003d m c_v \\Delta T$ | $Q \u003d 0$ |\n\n*   $\\kappa \u003d c_p"
      }, {
        "text": "/c_v$. Za enoatomne pline $\\kappa \\approx 1.67$, dvoatomne $\\approx 1."
      }, {
        "text": "4$.\n*   Mayerjeva enačba: $c_p \u003d c_v + R/M"
      }, {
        "text": "$.\n\n---\n\n### 🔥 SPECIAL CASES FOR EXAMS (Calculus Application)\n\n**1. Čas praznjenja posode (2"
      }, {
        "text": "011 Naloga 3)**\nKo gladina pada, se hitrost iztekanja manjša.\n$$"

        "text": " \\quad \\Rightarrow \\quad dt \u003d -\\frac{S_p}{S_l \\sqrt{2g}} h"

        "text": "^{-1/2} dh $$\nIntegriraj od $H_{start}$ do $0$:\n$$ t \u003d \\frac{"

        "text": "S_p}{S_l} \\sqrt{\\frac{2H}{g}} $$\n\n**2. Deb"
      }, {
        "text": "eljenje ledu (2011 Naloga 4)**\nToplota strjevanja mora uiti skozi plast"

        "text": " ledu debeline $x$.\n$$ P \u003d \\lambda S \\frac{\\Delta T}{x} \\quad \\"
